description: This file is a C source file that implements a small command-line tool to compile pcap filter expressions into precompiled BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) code. It reads a filter expression from the command line, compiles it using libpcap, and outputs C code representing the compiled filter.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Program entry point, processes the filter expression argument, compiles it, and outputs the corresponding C code.
